title: QuestDB (YC S20) Is Hiring a Sales Engineer
summary: QuestDB, a Y Combinator-backed time-series database company, is recruiting a Pre-Sales Engineer for North America to support their sales team. This role bridges technical expertise with business development, helping prospects understand and implement QuestDB's database solutions.
problem_solved: Helps technical prospects evaluate and adopt QuestDB's high-performance time-series database through technical demonstrations and solution design.
why_valuable: As a Pre-Sales Engineer, this role directly drives revenue growth by translating complex technical capabilities into business value for potential customers in the fast-growing time-series data market.
